name: helm-monorepo
description: Helm — AI voice-first game guide/referee for Warhammer 40,000

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,dice,voice,web -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dice" "npm run dev:voice" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd packages/shared-types && npm install && cd ../../services/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../state-engine && npm install && cd ../rules-engine && npm install && cd ../dice-service && npm install && cd ../voice-service && npm install && cd ../../apps/web-console && npm install
